_note: The yearly page (data/events/year_record.json): Tome brings this New Year's page of the village record. greet comes before the page, after once it is closed: record_first (the farmer's first page, year 2), record_more (more stars than the last page), else a steady year. Our own lines.

lines.speaker: tome
lines.text: A happy new year! I've just come from writing in the village record, and I brought your page along.

lines.speaker: tome
lines.text: There's the first day you came, and there's today. Have a look.

lines.speaker: tome
lines.text: Some years the field grows, some years the farmer does. Both go in the book.

lines.speaker: tome
lines.text: Your first whole year. A year ago that field was nothing but weeds and stones, you know.

lines.speaker: tome
lines.text: The big page comes after the second year. I'll be watching!

lines.speaker: tome
lines.text: More stars than last year! I had to sharpen my brush twice.

lines.speaker: tome
lines.text: Well, I've the rest of the village to visit. Look after yourself this year.
